main.description: Aggregate receipt activity per model and per time window. Walks the most-recent indexed receipts (capped at 5000), groups by `body.model`, and tallies requests + tokens across the hour/day/week/month windows, with per-provider breakdowns. The scan cap is reported back as `scanned`/`scanLimit`/`truncated` so consumers can tell an exact total from a lower bound; `oldestScannedAt` is the earliest receipt that contributed to any window.

scanned.description: Number of indexed receipts this scan walked.

scanLimit.description: Cap the scan applied (receipts are walked newest-first).

truncated.description: True when the scan filled its cap, so older receipts exist that these totals do not include. The wider windows (week/month) are then lower bounds.

oldestScannedAt.description: Earliest receipt timestamp that contributed to any window, so a consumer can state the coverage of the counts. Absent when nothing counted.
